authenticated_latest_ci.name: BIL focused source finalization without tests

matching_workflow_events.event_definition:
name: android-debug-build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - phase-3-product-excellence
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: android-debug-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

name: BIL guarded functional source preparation
# Only the authorized integration branch. No builds, deploy, Full8, or stores.
on:
  push:
    branches: [integration/bil-qa-media-policy-20261011]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/bil_candidate_prepare_20261011.yml
      - docs/qa_next/candidate_20261011/**
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: bil-functional-source-prepare
  cancel-in-progress: false

name: BIL focused source finalization without tests
# Authorized source preparation only; no Full8, behavioral tests, builds or deployment.
on:
  push:
    branches: [integration/bil-qa-media-policy-20261011]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/bil_functional_finish_20261011.yml
      - docs/qa_next/functional_finish_20261011/**
  workflow_dispatch:
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: bil-functional-source-prepare
  cancel-in-progress: false

name: BIL instant experience isolated QA

# Inspection artifact only. No builds, deployment, secrets or source writeback.
on:
  push:
    branches: [integration/bil-qa-media-policy-20261011]
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/bil_instant_experience_qa.yml
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

name: BIL isolated integration focused QA

# Scope is restricted to the post-Codex media+policy integration only.
# No full 8-shard run, builds, secrets, deployment, or source writeback.
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - integration/bil-qa-media-policy-20261011
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/bil_integration_media_policy_focused.yml
      - lib/**
      - test/**
      - tool/prebuild/**
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: bil-integration-focused-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

name: verify

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - phase-3-product-excellence
      - fix/admob-clean-production-2026-10-02
  pull_request:
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: verify-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
